## D — Accuracy

Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the reporting threshold and the crash-scene duties resolve to the first selected page, the safety responsibility law and its filings to the second, and the insurance requirement, coverages, lawsuit conditions and penalties to the third.

Confidence: high across the section; every amount and duty is printed directly on its page. One source-form caution: on the first page the word crash is set in a separate text run that interleaves with the paragraphs in the snapshot's text layer, so those sentences were reassembled in reading order and confirmed against the rendered page.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the what to do at a crash, the reporting threshold, the safety responsibility law and its filings, mandatory insurance coverages, when you can sue for injury, and the insurance law penalties rules on pages 52–54 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
